# Noto Sans SC

Unmodified variable font from Google Fonts commit
`2894aab31764f10f29c421bdfd2340d3b382d384`, path
`ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC[wght].ttf`, stored as `NotoSansSC.ttf`.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/2894aab31764f10f29c421bdfd2340d3b382d384/ofl/notosanssc

Copyright 2014–2021 Adobe. SIL Open Font License 1.1; see the original `OFL.txt`.
The font and license are installed together in `resources/xlsx`. Csrio loads this
font only inside its XLSX renderer; it does not install it into the operating system.

Font SHA-256: `a3041811a78c361b1de50f953c805e0244951c21c5bd412f7232ef0d899af0da`.
